hero.title: Move freely again.
hero.lede: Chiropractic care that tests how you move, treats the cause, and re-tests every visit. Scroll through one lower back, from the first visit to bending freely.

stages.c: A full history and movement exam. You can only bend so far before it bites, so we measure where.
Stiff joints low in the back and tight hips are doing the damage. No scans needed.
Gentle adjustments and soft tissue work to free the stiff joints and calm things down.
Daily hip and spine mobility at home, five minutes a day.
Core and hip strength so the back is supported, not just loosened.
Bending to the floor without thinking about it. Check-ins once a month, if you want them.

where.title: Where does it hurt?
where.sub: Pick the area that's bothering you to see what we usually find, how many sessions it tends to take, and what to do in the meantime.

areas.line: Very common and rarely serious. Most backs get better faster when you keep gently moving.
areas.flag: Numbness around the groin, or trouble with your bladder or bowels.

areas.line: Often posture and stress as much as injury. We treat it and change what keeps causing it.
areas.flag: Pain after a big impact, or weakness in both arms.

areas.line: Hip pain can come from the joint, the tendons on the side, or even the back. We find which.
areas.meanwhile: Avoid sleeping on the sore side
areas.flag: Sudden severe pain with a fever.

areas.line: Many headaches start in a stiff neck and upper back. We check that first.
areas.flag: A sudden, severe headache unlike any before.

treatments.title: Simple pricing, no plans to buy.
treatments.sub: Pay per visit. We will tell you at the first visit how many we expect it to take.

treats.d: Exam, first adjustment and a written plan
Therapeutic massage, back or full body

book.title: Pick a time that works.
book.sub: Choose who you'd like to see and a slot. New patients start with a full assessment; you'll get a text the day before.
book.note: Wear comfortable clothes. Cancel free up to 24 hours before.
